{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")
print(refunded_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])"}
